comment: Capability declaration for Pulp's bounded Standard MIDI File subset.
The reader and writer carry flat note tracks plus tempo and meter maps.
Every other authored timeline concept is either refused on import or
reported through the export plan before the adapter may omit it.

clip.musical.notes: positions are exact when the file division divides the canonical tick grid; otherwise import reports bounded nearest-tick rounding

tempo.single.notes: tempo periods are represented as integer microseconds and may round on import

tempo.map.notes: tempo positions may use bounded nearest-tick rounding on non-dividing file grids, and periods are integer microseconds

meter.single.notes: meter positions may use bounded nearest-tick rounding on non-dividing file grids

meter.map.notes: time-signature changes are admitted only when they land on canonical bar boundaries

clip.empty.loss: Standard MIDI Files have no positioned empty-clip object, so the clip is omitted

clip.absolute.loss: sample-anchored clips cannot be placed on the Standard MIDI File tick grid, so the clip and its content are omitted

clip.media.loss: Standard MIDI Files carry MIDI events rather than audio media, so media clips are omitted

clip.gain.loss: Standard MIDI Files have no per-clip gain, so authored clip gain is omitted

clip.fades.loss: Standard MIDI Files have no per-clip fades, so authored fade-in and fade-out durations are omitted

clip.fade-shape.loss: Standard MIDI Files have no per-clip fades, so a non-linear fade curve is omitted with the fade it shaped

clip.launch.loss: Standard MIDI Files describe a linear arrangement, so launcher scenes are omitted

clip.note-modifier.loss: Standard MIDI notes carry no probability, pass condition, or ratchet, so the notes play unconditionally once

clip.note-velocity-quantized.loss: 16-bit note velocities are quantized to the nearest nonzero 7-bit Standard MIDI velocity

tempo.ramp.loss: continuous tempo curves become discrete Set Tempo steps at the authored tempo points

tempo.value-quantized.loss: tempo values are rounded to the nearest representable integer microseconds per quarter note

sequence.multiple.loss: only the root sequence is written; other sequences are omitted

sequence.nested.loss: nested sequence placements have no Standard MIDI File representation and are omitted

content.registered.loss: registered extension clip content has no Standard MIDI File representation and is omitted

content.opaque.loss: opaque extension clip content has no Standard MIDI File representation and is omitted

marker.loss: the bounded writer does not emit marker meta-events, so markers and regions are omitted

timecode.origin.loss: the bounded writer does not emit a session timecode origin, so the document opens at zero

mixer.track-gain.loss: the bounded writer does not lower authored track gain to MIDI controller events

mixer.track-pan.loss: the bounded writer does not lower authored track pan to MIDI controller events

device.placement.loss: device chains have no Standard MIDI File representation and are omitted

automation.device-param.loss: the bounded writer does not lower device automation to MIDI controller events

automation.track-gain.loss: the bounded writer does not lower track-gain automation to MIDI controller events

automation.track-pan.loss: the bounded writer does not lower track-pan automation to MIDI controller events

take.lane.loss: takes and comp lanes have no Standard MIDI File representation and are omitted

take.comp.loss: take comp selections have no Standard MIDI File representation and are omitted

track.freeze.loss: frozen audio renders have no Standard MIDI File representation and are omitted

asset.sealed-hash.loss: Standard MIDI Files do not carry Pulp media identity hashes

asset.embedded-media.loss: Standard MIDI Files do not embed authored media assets

asset.referenced-media.loss: Standard MIDI Files do not retain external media locators

context.chord-scale.loss: the bounded writer does not emit chord or scale context

context.groove.loss: the bounded writer does not apply or serialize authored groove context
